name: B10-0402/2025 – Motion for a resolution
title: MOTION OF CENSURE ON THE COMMISSION MOTION OF CENSURE ON THE COMMISSION
part_text:
This is a motion of censure: a formal attempt by some Members of the European Parliament to force the European Commission to resign. It does not change any law. It asks Parliament to reject the EU–US trade deal and the EU–Mercosur agreement, to suspend the EU–Israel Association Agreement and sanction Israel, and to condemn the Commission's record on social and climate issues. It ends by saying the Commission has lost Parliament's confidence and should resign.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. It is a request for the Commission to resign and for several deals to be rejected.
- **Who it affects:** The Commission, EU trade deals with the US and Mercosur, and EU relations with Israel.
- **What happens next:** Members vote on the motion. If it passes, the Commission must resign.
